{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm the sites are only three, not four
print(f"Unique sites: {df['site'].unique()}")

# Check response rate by site
response_by_site = df.groupby('site')['responded'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
print(f"Response rates:\n{response_by_site}")

# Check for confounding: is the response rate confounded by arm or severity?
# Cross-tabulate site vs arm
print(f"\nSite vs Arm:\n{pd.crosstab(df['site'], df['arm'])}")

# Cross-tabulate site vs severity
print(f"\nSite vs Severity:\n{pd.crosstab(df['site'], df['severity'])}")

# Check if the groups are comparable
# Compute overall response rate by arm and severity
print(f"\nOverall response by arm:\n{df.groupby('arm')['responded'].mean()}")
print(f"\nOverall response by severity:\n{df.groupby('severity')['responded'].mean()}")

# Check if site imbalance exists in arm or severity
print(f"\nArm distribution per site:\n{pd.crosstab(df['site'], df['arm'])}")
print(f"\nSeverity distribution per site:\n{pd.crosstab(df['site'], df['severity'])}")"}
